name: moods
//: Seven faces, in place of a set taken from an icon library. Asked for four ways before one held: as icons with no brief, as SVG written to a brief, as SVG to a brief a designer would sign off, and finally as one drawn sheet — which is the one that reads. What the brief had to say by then, learned a rejection at a time: every feature inside the head with clear space to the rim, the two brows two separate strokes that never meet, eyes as dots or short strokes and never small rings, few features and big ones, one heavy pen.
//marks: No sad one, and no sleeping one. Seven marks that jump on the beat are a room enjoying itself; a long face in the middle of that row is somebody who has had bad news, and eight of them at 36 dots come to 184 cells, which is past an ordinary terminal and drops the whole row to 24.
//heights: Traced from a drawing, so the pen is measured off it and taken to two dots — at three the features inside the circle close up.
